$description: DOS-86 (dos-86, DMNC-1643) - the web counterpart of the DOS-86 terminal theme. Amber text and borders exactly as in Pure Amber, on the DOS-86 screen colour #050300; the functional colours are honest (red error, green success, yellow warning, cyan info, red destructive fills), following the role layer of the DOS-86 terminal theme. Not the default yet: opt in with eidotter/themes/dos-86.css and data-theme="dos-86".

cga.$description: The CGA palette with honest hues (as in cga-amber), except black, which is the DOS-86 screen #050300, and the other neutral slots, which keep Pure Amber's values so secondary text, the card surface and visited links look as they do today.

black.$description: The DOS-86 terminal screen: warm near-black, about 3% amber (as in cga-amber). Pure Amber's ground is #020003.

green.$description: CGA green. Success fill, added lines.

red.$description: CGA red. Destructive fill (white text on it). Too dark for text on the ground.

brown.$description: Pure Amber's brown, kept: visited links use it.

lightGray.$description: Pure Amber's warm tan-amber, kept: secondary and muted text. The DOS-86 terminal's amberSoft.

darkGray.$description: Pure Amber's near-black, kept: secondary surface.

brightGreen.$description: CGA bright green. Success text, border and status.

brightRed.$description: CGA bright red. Error text, border and status (CGA red #AA0000 is too dark to read on the ground).

yellow.$description: CGA yellow. Warning; lemon enough to stand apart from amber text.

white.$description: Warm off-white (about 2% amber), as in cga-amber.

error.$description: DMNC-1643: honest red destructive fill (#AA0000); text on it is text.white (#FFFFFF, 7.7:1). Pure Amber uses amberDim here.

secondary.$description: DMNC-1494: visible de-emphasised tone on dark backgrounds. For dark text on an amber fill use `text.onAccent`.

onAccent.$description: DMNC-1494: dark text/icon sitting on an accent (amber) fill.

onLight.$description: DMNC-1494: near-black text/icon for an unfilled element sitting on a light surface (e.g. Nav modern links). Near-black in every theme.

accent.$description: Pure Amber's accent yellow (its color.cga.yellow), kept as a value because color.cga.yellow is the honest warning yellow here. Accent text is not a functional colour.

success.$description: DMNC-1643: honest green (#55FF55), the DOS-86 success role.

error.$description: DMNC-1643: honest red (#FF5555), the DOS-86 error role.

warning.$description: DMNC-1643: honest yellow (#FFFF55), the DOS-86 warning role. Pure Amber inherits amber here.

info.$description: DMNC-1643: honest cyan (#00AAAA), the DOS-86 info role.

hover.$description: Pure Amber's hover yellow (its color.cga.yellow), kept as a value; see text.accent.

success.$description: DMNC-1643: honest green border, the DOS-86 success role.

error.$description: DMNC-1643: honest red border, the DOS-86 error role.

info.$description: DMNC-1643: dark blue alert ground, as in cga-amber.

success.$description: DMNC-1643: dark green alert ground; the DOS-86 added-line fill.

warning.$description: DMNC-1643: dark yellow alert ground, as in cga-amber.

error.$description: DMNC-1643: dark red alert ground; the DOS-86 removed-line fill.
DMNC-1643: honest red destructive hover-glow. Pure Amber uses amber here.

color.$description: Pure Amber's focus-ring yellow (its color.cga.yellow), kept as a value so the keyboard focus ring looks as it does today; color.cga.yellow is the warning yellow here.
